title: If Quantum Measurements Are Secretly Continuous Nonunitary Processes, Weak Measurements Can Detect It
summary: The standard approach to quantum measurements is to assume that they lead to effectively instantaneous collapse of the quantum state. However, if we assume that we are unable to enforce at what exact moment of time the measurement occurs due to a finite resolution of any time measurement device, at the level of the ensemble, the measurement would lead to an effectively nonunitary evolution involving a mixed state.
